# keyfactor_certificate_collection (Data Source)

Reads an existing Keyfactor Command certificate collection by name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The internal Keyfactor Command identifier of the certificate collection to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be provided.
- `name` (String) The name of the certificate collection to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be provided.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The query string that defines the certificate collection.
- `description` (String) A description of the certificate collection.
- `duplication_field` (Number) An integer indicating how duplicate certificate subjects are determined for the certificate collection.
- `estimated_cert_count` (Number) The estimated number of certificates that match the certificate collection query.
- `favorite` (Boolean) Whether the certificate collection is marked as a favorite.
- `last_estimated` (String) The timestamp of the last time the estimated certificate count was calculated.
- `show_on_dashboard` (Boolean) Whether the certificate collection is shown on the Keyfactor Command dashboard.
